en.tagline: Run hosted AI apps from a CLI, no GPU needed
en.summary: agent-tools is a skill that gives an agent access to inference.sh through the belt CLI. It can run hosted AI apps for images, video, LLMs, web search, 3D generation, and Twitter/X actions. You pass each app a JSON input and get the result back, without setting up your own models or GPUs.
problem: Using image, video, LLM, search, and 3D models usually means separate accounts, separate APIs, and often your own GPU setup. Each one has its own input format and its own way of tracking jobs.
With this skill, the agent calls every hosted app through one CLI command with a JSON input. Local files can be passed by path, and the CLI uploads them for you.
fit: Generating images or videos from a script or agent
Calling LLMs or web search (Tavily, Exa) from the shell
Posting to Twitter/X or running actions like DMs, follows, likes, and retweets
unfit: Work that must run offline or on your own hardware
Tasks that need a model or app not listed in the inference.sh catalog
steps: Log in with `belt login`, or set `INFERENCE_API_KEY` in non-interactive shells.
Find an app with `belt app search "flux"` or `belt app list --category image`.
Read the app's inputs with `belt app get <app>` and create a starter file with `belt app sample <app> --save input.json`.
Run the app with `belt app run <app> --input input.json`, or add `--no-wait` to return before the job finishes.
Check a background job with `belt task get <task-id>`.
Pass local file paths in the input, and the CLI uploads them automatically.

zh.tagline: 在命令行运行云端AI应用，无需GPU
zh.summary: agent-tools 是一个技能，让智能体通过 belt CLI 使用 inference.sh。它可以运行云端托管的 AI 应用，用于生成图片和视频、调用大语言模型、网页搜索、生成 3D 模型，以及执行 Twitter/X 操作。每个应用接收一段 JSON 输入并返回结果，无需自己部署模型或配置 GPU。
problem: 使用图像、视频、大语言模型、搜索和 3D 模型，通常需要分别注册账号、对接不同的 API，有时还要自己配置 GPU。每种服务的输入格式和任务追踪方式也各不相同。
使用这个技能后，智能体只需通过一个 CLI 命令、传入 JSON 输入，就能调用所有云端应用。本地文件可以直接写路径，CLI 会自动上传。
fit: 在脚本或智能体中生成图片、视频
在命令行中调用大语言模型或网页搜索（Tavily、Exa）
发布 Twitter/X 内容，或执行私信、关注、点赞、转推等操作
unfit: 必须离线运行或只能在本地硬件上运行的任务
需要 inference.sh 应用目录中没有的模型或应用的任务
steps: 执行 `belt login` 登录，或在非交互式终端中设置 `INFERENCE_API_KEY`。
用 `belt app search "flux"` 或 `belt app list --category image` 查找应用。
用 `belt app get <app>` 查看应用的输入参数，再用 `belt app sample <app> --save input.json` 生成示例输入文件。
用 `belt app run <app> --input input.json` 运行应用；加上 `--no-wait` 可在任务完成前直接返回。
用 `belt task get <task-id>` 查看后台任务的状态。
输入中可以直接写本地文件路径，CLI 会自动上传这些文件。
